blocks.text: Kirchhoff ke rules circuit analysis ke do bunyadi usool hain jo circuits mein current aur voltage maloom karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh khaas taur par un pecheeda (complex) circuits ke liye kaam aate hain jo sirf Ohm ke qanoon aur series ya parallel jor se hal nahi ho sakte.
Kirchhoff ka pehla rule
Yeh kehta hai ke circuit mein kisi point par milne wale saare currents ka jor (sum) zero hota hai:
Riwayat (convention) yeh hai ke point ki taraf aane wala current musbat aur point se door jane wala current manfi liya jata hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat ke liye (For Your Information)
blocks.text: Node circuit ka woh point hai jo do ya zyada shaakhon (branches) ko jorta hai.
Maan lein chaar taar ek point A par milte hain (Fig. 9.27). A ki taraf aane wale currents I₁ aur I₂ hain aur door jane wale I₃ aur I₄.

blocks.alt: Chaar taarein, har ek mein resistor, nuqte A par milti hain. Teer: I1 (baen se) aur I2 (neeche baen se) A ki taraf; I3 (neeche daen) aur I4 (oopar daen) A se door.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.27: Kirchhoff ke pehle qaide ke mutabiq I1 + I2 = I3 + I4 (kitab ki Figure 9.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Fig. 9.27 ki caption mein I₁ + I₃ = I₂ + I₄ chhapti hai, jo us ke apne text aur Eq. 9.44 ke khilaf hai. A mein aane wale currents I₁ aur I₂ hain, is liye sahi rishta I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄ hai.
Riwayat ke mutabiq I₁ aur I₂ musbat aur I₃ aur I₄ manfi hain. Eq. 9.43 lagane se:
Eq. 9.44 se pehla rule doosre lafzon mein:

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka pehla rule
blocks.text: Kisi point ki taraf aane wale saare currents ka jor us point se door jane wale saare currents ke jor ke barabar hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: Jis node ka potential zero maana jaye use datum node kehte hain.

Kirchhoff ka pehla rule (jise point rule bhi kehte hain) charge ki conservation (charge na banta hai na mit-ta hai) ke qanoon ki shakal hai. Agar kisi point par charge jama ya paida na ho raha ho to jitna charge point ki taraf aata hai utna hi us se door jata hai.
Kirchhoff ka doosra rule

Yeh kehta hai ke kisi band circuit (loop) mein voltage ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic jor zero hona chahiye. Fig. 9.28 ka band circuit lein. Current I ki simt us cell par munhasir hai jis ka emf zyada ho. Maan lein E₁ bara hai, is liye current anticlockwise (ghari ki ulti simt) behta hai. Steady current musbat charges ka lagatar bahao samjha ja sakta hai. Voltage ki tabdeeli woh kaam (ya energy) hai jo unit musbat charge ek point se doosre tak jate hue hasil karta ya khota hai.

Jab musbat charge Q cell E₁ mein kam (−) se zyada (+) potential ki taraf guzarta hai to us par kaam hota hai aur woh energy E₁Q hasil karta hai (Eq. 9.41 se). Cell E₂ mein se guzarte hue charge zyada se kam potential ki taraf jata hai, is liye energy E₂Q khota hai (−E₂Q). Resistor R₁ mein charge zyada se kam potential ki taraf jata hai aur energy IR₁Q khota hai (−IR₁Q); isi tarah R₂ mein −IR₂Q. Aakhir charge wapas E₁ ke manfi terminal par pohanch jata hai jahan se chala tha. Energy ki conservation se kul tabdeeli zero hai:

blocks.alt: Mustateel loop: oopar ki taar mein resistance R1 aur cell E1, baen taraf cell E2, neeche resistance R2. Darmiyan khamdaar teer I: current anticlockwise.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.28: Kirchhoff ke doosre qaide ke mutabiq E1 - IR1 - E2 - IR2 = 0 (kitab ki Figure 9.28 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E₁ bara hai, is liye current anticlockwise hai. E₁ mein charge − se + jata hai (energy milti hai, +E₁); E₂ mein + se − (energy khota hai, −E₂); R₁ aur R₂ mein current ki simt mein −IR₁ aur −IR₂. Sab ka jor zero.
Yehi Kirchhoff ka doosra rule hai:

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka doosra rule
blocks.text: Kisi band circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic jor zero hota hai.
Yeh rule asal mein energy ki conservation ka qanoon hai, bas bijli ke masail ki zabaan mein.
Pecheeda network par yeh rule lagane se pehle potential ki tabdeeli ke signs achhi tarah samajh lein:

items: Agar cell ko musbat (+) se manfi (−) terminal ki taraf paar karein to potential ki tabdeeli manfi (−E) hai; ulti simt (− se +) mein musbat (+E).
Agar resistor ko current ki simt mein paar karein to potential ki tabdeeli manfi (−IR) hai; current ke khilaf musbat (+IR).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke likhe hue rules (i) aur (ii) ulte signs dete hain: un ke mutabiq cell ko + se − aur resistor ko current ki simt mein paar karne par tabdeeli musbat hai. Yeh ghalat hai: + se − jane par potential girta hai (−E), aur current ki simt mein resistor par bhi potential girta hai (−IR). Kitab ka apna "For your information" box, Example 9.10 aur procedure ka qadam (iv) yahi sahi signs istemal karte hain.

blocks.caption: Maloomat ke liye: E aur I ke signs
rows: Cell − se + ki taraf (kam se zyada potential)

blocks.alt: Do loops wala circuit, oopar nuqte e, b, a aur neeche f, c, d. Teeno khari shaakhon mein resistor ke oopar cell: baen E3 aur R3, darmiyan E2 aur R2, daen E1 aur R1. Clockwise teer loop currents I2 (baen loop) aur I1 (daen loop). Qeematein: R1 = 10 ohm, R2 = 30 ohm, R3 = 15 ohm; E1 = 40 V, E2 = 60 V, E3 = 50 V.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 9.29 mein "R₃ = 50V" chhapa hai; resistance volt mein nahi hoti aur R₃ = 15 Ω pehle hi diya gaya hai. Hal mein E₃ = 50 V istemal hota hai, is liye yahan E₃ = 50 V likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech wali shaakh (R₂, E₂) dono loops mein hai, is liye us mein current I₁ − I₂ hai. Dono loop currents ek hi simt (clockwise) mein farz kiye gaye hain.

blocks.title: Example 9.10
blocks.problem: Fig. 9.29 ke circuit ki teeno resistances mein current nikalein. R₁ = 10 Ω, R₂ = 30 Ω, R₃ = 15 Ω; E₁ = 40 V, E₂ = 60 V, E₃ = 50 V.
steps: Do loops chunein: abcda aur ebcfe; har resistance kam az kam ek loop mein aa jaye.
Pehle loop mein loop current I₁ aur doosre mein I₂ farz karein, dono clockwise (ek hi simt mein).
Loop abcda (a se clockwise): E₁ ko + se − paar karte hain: −E₁; R₁ mein −I₁R₁; R₂ mein is loop ka current I₁ musbat aur I₂ manfi, is liye −(I₁ − I₂)R₂; E₂ ko − se + paar karte hain: +E₂.
Loop ebcfe: −E₂ − (I₂ − I₁)R₂ − I₂R₃ + E₃ = 0 → −60 − 30(I₂ − I₁) − 15I₂ + 50 = 0
(i) se I₁ = (2 + 3I₂)/4; (ii) mein rakhein: 3 + 4.5I₂ − 9I₂ = 2, is liye I₂ = 2/9 A = 0.22 A aur I₁ = 2/3 A = 0.66 A
R₁ mein asal current = I₁ = 2/3 A = 0.66 A, a se d ki taraf.
R₂ mein asal current = I₁ − I₂ = 2/3 A − 2/9 A = 4/9 A = 0.44 A, bare current I₁ ki simt mein, c se b ki taraf.
blocks.answer: R₃ mein asal current = I₂ = 2/9 A = 0.22 A, f se e ki taraf.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hal mein kitab likhti hai "Fig. 9.28 shows that I₁ and I₂ are the actual currents"; is example ka circuit Fig. 9.29 hai.
Circuit ke masail hal karne ka tareeqa
Is misal ke baad hum yehi tareeqa doosre pecheeda D.C. networks par laga sakte hain. Kirchhoff ke rules istemal karte waqt yeh qadam uthayein:

items: Loops aise chunein ke har resistance kam az kam ek loop mein shamil ho.
Har loop mein ek loop current farz karein; saare loop currents ek hi simt mein hon, clockwise ya anticlockwise.
Har chune hue loop ki equation likhein: kisi hisse ko kam se zyada potential ki taraf paar karein to voltage ki tabdeeli musbat, zyada se kam ki taraf manfi.
In equations ko hal kar ke na-maloom quantities nikalein.

blocks.prompt: "Poore circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic jor zero hai": yeh kis ka bayan hai (MCQ 9.9)? Kirchhoff ke rules bayan karein aur samjhayein (comprehensive question 9.2).
blocks.explanation: Yeh Kirchhoff ka doosra rule hai: option (d). Pehla rule: kisi junction par aane wale currents ka jor jane wale currents ke jor ke barabar hai (ΣI = 0), kyun ke charge mehfooz (conserved) rehta hai. Doosra rule: kisi bhi band loop mein emfs aur IR tabdeeliyon ka algebraic jor zero hai, kyun ke unit charge cells se jitni energy leta hai utni hi resistors mein kharch karta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Pehla rule (point rule, charge ki conservation): junction par ΣI = 0; I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄ (9.44).
Doosra rule (loop rule, energy ki conservation): band loop mein potential tabdeeliyon ka algebraic jor = 0; E₁ − IR₁ − E₂ − IR₂ = 0 (9.45).
Signs: cell − se + par +E; current ke saath resistor −IR.
Example 9.10: R₁ mein 0.66 A, R₂ mein 0.44 A, R₃ mein 0.22 A. Tareeqa: diagram, loops, ek simt ke loop currents, equations, hal.
